text.text_excerpt: hm... It's a shame this place doesn't have the best reviews. It is after all, a budget friendly hotel. It's beautiful in the lobby/breakfast/bar area. Clean, bright and fresh. It's definitely within walking district to everything... unless you're legs are broke or you're so out of shape blowing out birthday candles is a chores. We walked every day/night to bourbon street, Jackson square, the flea market, even a local joint that was out of the way and tucked down a weird side street i'll never remember the name of. Maybe the issue is your walking shoes... There are restaurants and bars nearby and canal and bourbon street are just a few blocks. I'm also not sure why people said it's not saf...

I really enjoyed my stay at this property. The location is great; an easy walk to the Quarter but away from the madness. Service was excellent from check in to check out. We were there over Christmas, and the staff was enthusiastic to be there, holiday or not. Rooms are comfortable and roomy, and ours had a great view with gorgeous sunsets most very night. Breakfast here is good, not great, but HGI gives Hilton Honors members the option of free points or free breakfast, and it was so nice to eat in and plan our day, and the restaurant staff is terrific. I had read some of the reviews here before booking my trip. I arrived a bit early but they were happy to let me check in. The front desk staff were very friendly, pleasant and professional. They gave me an upgrade to a mini suit, which was nice. I took pics of the room. I was on the 16th of 18 floor - I like it high up!! The room was nice and cozy, with a microwave and mini fridge - great to have some snacks. The view could have been better. The bed and bedding were amazing! Very comfortable - I did not want to get out of bed in the morning. Everything was clean and it working order. The furnishings were a bit old and dated but that was okay.
